definitions: An American media franchise created by Kevin Eastman and Peter Laird, primarily focused on four anthropomorphic turtles trained by a rat sensei in ninjutsu.
The fictional team of four anthropomorphic turtle brothers who are ninjas, named Leonardo, Donatello, Michelangelo, and Raphael.
examples: I grew up watching TMNT cartoons.
The new TMNT movie is coming out next month.
My favorite TMNT character is Michelangelo.
